content.json:
# ShopFlow: operations overview
Saga funnel, queue backlogs, RU cost per container and errors per service. Queries from docs/kql.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize Calls = sum(ItemCount), Failures = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false), P95ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by AppRoleName
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Calls and failures per service (1 h)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and Name == "shopflow.messaging.processed"
| extend MessageType = tostring(Properties["shopflow.message.type"]), Outcome = tostring(Properties["shopflow.outcome"])
| summarize Count = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), MessageType
| render timechart
content.title: Processed messages per type (saga funnel)

content.query:
CDBDataPlaneRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize RU = sum(RequestCharge), Throttled = countif(StatusCode == 429) by DatabaseName, CollectionName
| order by RU desc
content.title: Cosmos DB: RU and 429s per container (1 h)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and Name == "shopflow.readmodels.projection_lag"
| summarize P50 = percentile(Max, 50), P95 = percentile(Max, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: customer-orders projection lag (s)
